def linear_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) ->Number:
    input_shapes = [get_shape(v) for v in inputs[0:2]]
    assert len(input_shapes[0]) >= 2, input_shapes[0]

    input_shape = input_shapes[0]
    weight_shape = input_shapes[1]

    input_dim = input_shape[-1]

    flops = batch_size * input_dim * output_dim
    return flops

def conv_flop_count(x_shape: List[int], w_shape: List[int], out_shape: List[int], transposed: bool=False) ->Number:
    batch_size = x_shape[0]
    in_channels = x_shape[1]
    out_channels = w_shape[0]
    kernel_dims = w_shape[2:]
    out_size = prod(out_shape[2:])
    kernel_size = prod(kernel_dims)
    flops = batch_size * in_channels * out_channels * kernel_size * out_size

def conv_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) ->typing.Counter[str]:
    input_shape = get_shape(inputs[0])
    weight_shape = get_shape(inputs[1])
    output_shape = get_shape(outputs[0])
    transposed = inputs[6].toIValue()
    flops = conv_flop_count(input_shape, weight_shape, output_shape, transposed)
